related.why_read: Read this case when an event concerns export controls on chips or chipmaking equipment, especially toward China. It sets out one announced design in detail (items, end uses, reach beyond U.S.-made items, licensing policy, a temporary exception and phased timing), which gives concrete points of comparison. It does not show what happened afterwards.

matching_note: A case is shown as related to an event only when the event’s own text names the case’s policy instrument and also its sector or its country. A shared topic alone, such as oil, is listed as an overlap, not as a related case. Saved headline classifications are used only as labelled hints. Matching runs on this machine with a fixed word list: no model, no network and no score.
not_compared_note: Not compared by this check. The event's text is scanned only for the instrument, sector, country and agency; read the case to compare these yourself.
